messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: page fired for service=redwood-inference-routing region=eu-west-1 severity=high. Alert: 5xx spike on router-proxy x5m in the last 2m. Triggering auto-escalation to oncall team. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC12345

pagerduty: auto-ack assigned to kai (oncall). Escalation path: oncall -> ops-lead -> infra.

kai: ack - I'm taking this. seeing alerts on grafana, pulling logs now. tagging @sam @mira for triage.

sam: on it. quick glance: increases in `router-proxy` 5xx correlated with redis timeouts to kv-routing cluster (kvr-02). 90th latency for redis ops jumped to ~600ms.

mira: confirming, I can repro a small test request giving 503 with `backend: kv-conn-timeout`. Looks like connection storm to kvr-02; maybe new client burst.

jules: any recent deploys to routing or kvr? I don't see deploys in the last 30m. Could be scaling lag or network flaps. :eyes:

ops-lead: please capture list of impacted tenants. If customer-facing, escalate customer comms.

sam: quick customer check: partial impact — embeddings ingestion queue for tenant `acme-corp` showing 40% failures; other tenants mostly OK. marking `acme-corp` P1 potential.

kai: plan: 1) throttle new routing connections at edge to reduce pressure 2) reroute embed/low-priority traffic to eu-fallback pool 3) scale up kvr-02 nodes if needed. I'll attempt step 1 now.

mira: throttling rule applied on edge: `rate_limit:connects_per_minute=1200` for anonymous clients. Pushing rule via infra-cli: ```
infra-cli apply --service edge-router --patch '{"rate_limit": {"connects_per_minute": 1200}}'
```

jules: applied, saw connect rate drop ~35% within 30s. 5xx rate dipped from 18% -> 9%. good signal.

sam: initiating reroute for embeddings to eu-fallback-pool by changing route tag for that route: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.local/routing/rebind -d '{"route":"/embeddings","target":"eu-fallback-pool","percent":30}'
``` response 202.

kai: good. initiating scale-up for kvr-02 (adding 3 replicas) now: `k8s scale deployment/kvr-02 --replicas=6 --namespace=infra`

incident-bot: Incident update: assigned_to=kai status=acknowledged priority=high incident_id=INC12345. Next escalation in 10m if no progress.

ops-lead: live customer impact note: `acme-corp` ingestion degraded, SLO for embeddings at risk. Advising outreach to customer success.

mira: after reroute + throttle: 5xx down to 3.2%, redis latency trending back toward baseline. Embeddings retries for acme-corp showing steady success on fallback.

sam: logs show persistent error source: `kvr-02` connection pool exhaustion due to long-lived queries. We'll follow up with a config change to reduce `max_conn_lifetime` and add eviction. Filed follow-up ticket ENG-5289.

kai: handing ongoing monitoring to sam for next 30m. I'll stay on call but moving primary ownership -> sam. @ops-lead assigning ownership handoff.

pagerduty: ownership update: new_owner=sam previous_owner=kai. Acknowledged at 1738312405.

sam: taking over. will keep thread updated every 5-10m. current status: mitigation applied, customer-impact reduced, monitoring for regression. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Note: Post-incident actions recommended: RCA, customer comm draft, patch to kvr pool config. Recording incident timeline under INC12345.

ops-lead: agreed. high level summary to include timeline, mitigation steps (throttle, reroute, scale), root cause hypothesis (connection pool exhaustion), and follow-ups (ENG-5289).

sam: final ping for thread: moving to mitigation monitoring (30m). If stable, we'll mark as 'in progress' and transition to standard p1 playbook.

kai: thanks team. I'll loop in CS for acme-corp comms.

sam: last update at 1738312620: metrics stable, 5xx < 1.5% for last 2m. keeping ownership.
